tools.name: get_bitcoin_price
tools.title: Get current Bitcoin price
tools.description: Returns the current Bitcoin (BTC) spot price in USD (and optionally other fiat currencies) with 24-hour change. Sourced live from CoinGecko.

currencies.description: Optional list of fiat currency codes (e.g. ['usd','eur','gbp','try']). Defaults to ['usd'].

tools.name: convert_bitcoin
tools.title: Bitcoin/fiat converter
tools.description: Convert between BTC (or satoshis) and USD (or another fiat) at the current market price. Provide EITHER btc/sats OR fiat_amount, not both.

btc.description: Amount in BTC to convert TO fiat.

sats.description: Amount in satoshis (1 BTC = 100,000,000 sats) to convert TO fiat.

fiat_amount.description: Amount in fiat to convert TO BTC.

tools.name: calculate_bitcoin_what_if
tools.title: Bitcoin what-if investment
tools.description: Given a past investment date and USD amount, returns what that investment in Bitcoin would be worth today, including BTC amount, current value, gain/loss, and multiple.

date.description: Investment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Bitcoin history is available from 2013-04-28 onward.

usd_amount.description: Amount invested in USD on that date.

tools.name: simulate_bitcoin_dca
tools.title: Bitcoin DCA simulation
tools.description: Simulate a Dollar-Cost-Averaging strategy: buy a fixed USD amount of BTC on a regular cadence between two dates. Returns total invested, BTC accumulated, current value, and ROI.

end_date.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

usd_per_purchase.description: USD amount to buy each period.

tools.name: calculate_bitcoin_profit_loss
tools.title: Bitcoin profit/loss
tools.description: Calculate profit or loss on a Bitcoin trade from buy price, sell price, and amount. Returns absolute P/L, percentage return, and total invested/sold values.

buy_price_usd.description: Purchase price per BTC in USD.

sell_price_usd.description: Sell (or current) price per BTC in USD.

btc_amount.description: Amount of BTC in the position.

tools.name: get_bitcoin_halving_countdown
tools.title: Bitcoin halving countdown
tools.description: Returns the current block height, next halving block, estimated days until the next halving, and post-halving block subsidy.
